assumptions.spencerStart: ASSUMED — 718 Griffin Ave area, Enumclaw 98022. Spencer has no GPS tracker.
assumptions.onSiteNote: Per-tech median vehicle-GPS dwell at a customer stop, 2026-08-17..09-17. Spencer has no tracker, so he gets the all-tech median.
assumptions.travelModel: redesign/data/travel-model.json — observed OptimoRoute legs for pairs ever driven, per-driver haversine fit otherwise. Spencer falls back to the ALL-driver fit.
assumptions.hours: route hours = home to sequenced stops to home. paid span = first stop to last stop (paid time tracks first-job-to-last-job, so the commute is unpaid). capacity hours = the worse of route hours and (stops x measured GPS cycle minutes + commute).
assumptions.workdays: Tavis: Friday only, frozen. Spencer: Mon-Thu — nothing moves onto his Friday. Everyone else Mon-Fri.
assumptions.islandGround: Settled ground = the zip's dominant tech holds at least 80% of its completed visits in 2026-08-14..09-17 and the zip is not one of the five contested seams in seam-pack.json.
assumptions.dataCut: Jobber board pulled live. Product, activity flags and coordinates come from the 2026-09-18 jobs snapshot; last-completed dates are topped up live through 2026-09-18.
